text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So clooose!
You were right there, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: That's not true! Just one more mile—no, it felt like just 0.001 miles left!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
We'll definitely win it next time!
Let's come back to take it whenever you want~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
